verdict.rationale: Flagsmith supports multiple environments per project (dev/staging/production) and self-hosted Docker setups for local testing, plus RBAC to restrict who can modify production, which together enable testing without touching live production data. However, there's no explicit 'sandbox environment' feature, no documented isolated test/sandbox mode for AI agents specifically, and no mention of a dedicated non-production API key or test-data isolation guarantee tailored to AI-native workflows. missing for 10: explicit sandbox/test-environment feature documentation, AI-agent-specific sandbox guarantees, isolation of test data from production analytics/audit logs.
